# Thornmere Estate

> A private equestrian estate: a century-old timber and limestone barn restored for a small circle of riders. Livery, full board and a private club; viewings by appointment.

Thornmere Estate is a fictional estate. This website is a design study; no bookings or payments are taken.

## Site

- [The Estate](https://the-commits.github.io/equestrian-estate/#aisle): Heritage and architecture of the barn
- [Stabling](https://the-commits.github.io/equestrian-estate/#stalls): Stall craftsmanship: brass hardware, heated flooring, natural airflow
- [Membership](https://the-commits.github.io/equestrian-estate/#tack): Livery €1,800/month, Full Board €3,200/month, Private Club by invitation
- [Private Viewing](https://the-commits.github.io/equestrian-estate/#paddock): Viewing request form; also a WebMCP tool request_viewing
